facts_used.description: the charter facts this section shows, copied exactly

head.description: page-head tags this section needs (meta, link, style or script only); "" when it needs none

html.description: the section's HTML only: no <html>, <head> or <body> tags; "" when this workflow writes page-head tags only

selectors_used.description: the ids and classes you used
